notes:
- Palette colors now come built in, no teaching needed.
- Added Find my light, to pick out your light in a crowd.
- Your own lights now show first.
- Other people's lights fold away and are forgotten after a while.
- Long-press a light to pin it or hide it.
- Cleaned up the More tab.
- Uses less battery when the app isn't on screen.
- Asks before taking over someone else's lights.
- Added Share the app and Report a problem.
